article.title: Sitecore推出MarketingIQ，讓品牌跟進AI搜尋中的資料錯誤
article.title_en: Sitecore introduces MarketingIQ for following up on incorrect AI search answers
article.summary: 系統接合Scrunch的觀察與品牌核准資料，可擬議回應並交由行銷人員審批。
article.summary_en: MarketingIQ pairs Scrunch findings with approved brand information and stages proposed responses for marketers.
highlights: 公司以AI答案列出過時價格為例，說明如何擬備修正。
團隊可在發布前修改及批准內容。
highlights_en: Sitecore illustrates the workflow with an AI answer displaying an outdated price.
Teams can edit and approve content before publishing.
article.why: 品牌可把AI答案監察與內容更新交接連起來，清楚知道誰負責核對商品資料。
article.why_en: Brands can connect AI-answer monitoring to content updates and assign ownership of product facts.
article.next_step: 先選一項常被問及的商品資料，記錄錯誤答案、核准來源及更新負責人。
article.next_step_en: Choose one common product question and log the incorrect answer, approved source and update owner.
article.detail: Sitecore把監察結果與內容工作流程放在一起。若AI答案引用舊價格，團隊可用核准資料確認差異，再審閱系統擬備的修正。公告未承諾更新內容後，外部模型會立即更改答案。發布後可用相同問題複查多次，記下答案採用的來源與日期，並將可見度與訂單分開觀察。
article.detail_en: Sitecore connects monitoring with content operations. If an AI answer cites an outdated price, teams can compare it with the approved record and review a proposed correction. The announcement does not promise immediate changes in external answers. Recheck the same queries and track visibility separately from orders.
